# NowBuild

> NowBuild (nowbuild.ai) is a 30-day GTM (go-to-market) execution calendar for builders who shipped a product with AI but have never done marketing. It turns a 15-minute strategy conversation into a 30-day action calendar: every day it tells you what to post and where to post it, pre-drafts ~80% of the content with AI, and evolves the strategy through lightweight daily reviews.

NowBuild is NOT a generic AI copywriting tool. It connects strategy → daily calendar → pre-filled content → execution feedback into one loop. Alternatives like ChatGPT can discuss strategy but have no calendar or tracking; Notion templates have no AI or strategy binding; Buffer schedules posts but has no strategy layer.

## Who it's for

- First-time market builders: engineers, PMs and domain experts who shipped a side project (SaaS, AI tool, course, template, consulting) and don't know how to get their first users.
- Requires only 15–30 minutes per day for 30 days.

## Pricing

- Free: GTM kickoff strategy conversation, 7-day calendar preview, 3 AI-generated content pieces, channel recommendations.
- Pro: $19/month or $199/year. Full 30-day action calendar, unlimited AI content generation, 28+ channel skills, daily review cards, week-1 report and day-30 review.
